describe: The image shows an ornate gold treasure stand or small table seen from the front, with a flat top rim along the upper edge, a central oval gold medallion with filigree decoration, and curved gold straps angled from the medallion to the corners. Four curled claw-like feet sit at the bottom corners and a horizontal rail links the legs. Warm bright gold with darker brown shading in the recesses. Transparent background around the piece.
